property_summary: After a caller with zero balance calls airDrop(), the tokenBalance of the caller is 20 in the reference (which requires supportsToken) but 0 in the bug (which reverts because it requires supportsToken), but the buggy version without supportsToken allows the call to succeed, so tokenBalance becomes 20 in the bug and remains 0 in the reference because the reference reverts.
change_summary: Remove the supportsToken modifier, so any address can call airDrop without being a Bank
